answer: One purse cannot stretch across a hundred tolls, so the farm stalls at the gate. The desk only stamps a name that carries Accredited chorister workshop seal, and the stamp itself rests on a seal choristers renew after choir hearings. Trying costs a deposit of 68 credits, frozen until 7 days after the grading closes a name, and the money is gone whether the name passes or fails. Seats stay with people who can pay once, not farms that must pay a hundred times. The clerk notes comet. One voyage, one entry. Every knoll is counted once.
